svg.title: MeshFill Current Framework
svg.desc: Current MeshFill-Godot framework: TargetSceneVoxel target canvas, AutoObject descriptor-backed semantics, sparse candidate voxel-region indices, physical placement sampling SceneVoxelLocal views, source voxel write streams, blend_scene_voxels commit publish, same-level collision_voxels, and SceneVoxelLocal runtime sampling/query view.
svg.text: TargetSV is the source target canvas; TargetSV_B is brush-composited and used by routing/scoring.
no tree / rock / grass asset labels
physical validity stays in score pass
candidate list is not the sample field
index handle only, not default source
Rule: assets answer what they are
Rule: routing outputs candidate voxel regions
Rule: physical scoring decides if it can be placed
